firm_data.firm_description: Goldberg Weprin Finkel Goldstein LLP is a real estate law firm in New York. They handle high-value transactions, tax issues, litigation, and development and construction.
notable_facts: Named a 2023 Top 25 Real Estate Law Firm in NYC by The Real Deal.
Represented seller in a $506 million sale of a 911-unit multifamily complex in Brooklyn, New York.
Firm has been in practice for more than 75 years.

email.subject: AI for Goldberg Weprin Finkel Goldstein LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Andrew,

Congratulations on Goldberg Weprin being named a 2023 Top 25 Real Estate Law Firm in NYC by The Real Deal. That recognition reflects the caliber of work your team delivers on high-value transactions and complex tax issues.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in NYC to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
